senses.en: a diplomat fully authorized to represent their government

example.en: The plenipotentiary signed the treaty on behalf of her government.
example.zh: 全权代表代表本国政府签署了条约。

senses.en: having full authority to act

example.en: He was given plenipotentiary powers to negotiate the deal.
example.zh: 他被授予全权来谈判这笔交易。

senses.en: to chew food

example.en: Chew your food well to masticate it fully before swallowing.
example.zh: 吞咽前要把食物充分咀嚼。

senses.en: a product or service name made by a company

example.en: The brand is known for its outdoor clothing.
example.zh: 该品牌以户外服装闻名。

senses.en: to mark an animal with a hot iron to show ownership

example.en: Farmers brand cattle to show ownership.
example.zh: 农民给牛打烙印以标明归属。

senses.en: to describe or condemn someone or something in a strongly negative way

example.en: Critics branded the plan a failure.
example.zh: 批评者称该计划是失败的。

senses.en: most important, powerful, or influential

example.en: She plays a dominant role in the team.
example.zh: 她在团队中起主导作用。

senses.en: of a gene or allele that produces its effect even when only one copy is present

example.en: The dominant allele masks the effect of the recessive one.
example.zh: 显性等位基因掩盖了隐性等位基因的作用。

senses.en: the fifth note of a diatonic scale

example.en: The chord moves from the tonic to the dominant.
example.zh: 和弦从主音进行到属音。

senses.en: an amazing or wonderful event that seems very unlikely

example.en: It was a miracle that no one was hurt in the accident.
example.zh: 事故中没有人受伤，真是个奇迹。

senses.en: a wonderful event believed to be caused by a divine or supernatural power

example.en: Many pilgrims came to see the miracle.
example.zh: 许多朝圣者前来见证这一神迹。

senses.en: smart; able to think and learn quickly

example.en: She is an intelligent student who learns very quickly.
example.zh: 她是个学得很快的聪明学生。

senses.en: (of devices or systems) able to respond or adapt automatically using technology

example.en: The city uses intelligent traffic systems to reduce congestion.
example.zh: 这座城市使用智能交通系统来减少拥堵。

senses.en: the ability to know or comprehend something

example.en: Her explanation gave me a clear understanding of the problem.
example.zh: 她的解释让我清楚地理解了这个问题。

senses.en: an informal agreement or mutual sympathy between people

example.en: The two sides reached an understanding after a long discussion.
example.zh: 双方经过长时间讨论后达成了谅解。

senses.en: sympathetic and tolerant toward other people's feelings

example.en: He was very understanding when I explained the delay.
example.zh: 当我解释延误的原因时，他非常体谅。

senses.en: a person who uses something, especially a computer or a service

example.en: Each user must create an account before signing in.
example.zh: 每位用户必须先创建账户才能登录。

senses.en: a person who takes advantage of others selfishly or unethically

example.en: He was a user who only called when he needed help.
example.zh: 他是个只在需要帮助时才打电话的利用他人者。

senses.en: the way something is done or happens

example.en: Please reply in a timely manner.
example.zh: 请及时回复。

senses.en: a person's way of behaving or speaking

example.en: Her calm manner helped the children feel safe.
example.zh: 她平静的举止让孩子们感到安全。

senses.en: polite social behavior, used in the plural

example.en: It is good manners to thank your host.
example.zh: 感谢主人是有礼貌的。

senses.en: an amount of money that you pay for something or that you owe

example.en: The first payment is due next week.
example.zh: 第一笔款项下周到期。

senses.en: the act of giving money for goods or services

example.en: Payment can be made by card.
example.zh: 可以用银行卡付款。

senses.en: a hard, heavy metal used to make steel and many tools
senses.zh: 铁；一种坚硬、沉重的金属，用于炼钢和制造许多工具

example.en: The old gate is made of iron.
example.zh: 这扇旧门是用铁做的。

senses.en: an electrical device with a hot flat base, used to press clothes
senses.zh: 熨斗；一种底部发热的平底电器，用于熨平衣物

example.en: She filled the iron with water before using it.
example.zh: 她使用熨斗前先给它加水。

senses.en: to press clothes smooth with a heated iron
senses.zh: 熨；用加热的熨斗把衣物压平

example.en: He ironed his shirt before the meeting.
example.zh: 开会前他熨平了衬衫。

senses.en: to stop yourself from doing something

example.en: Please refrain from smoking in the building.
example.zh: 请勿在大楼内吸烟。

senses.en: a line or phrase repeated in a song or poem

example.en: The audience sang along to the refrain of the song.
example.zh: 观众跟着歌曲的副歌一起唱。

senses.en: not achieving the desired results with minimal waste of time, money, or effort

example.en: The old heating system is inefficient and wastes a lot of energy.
example.zh: 这套旧供暖系统效率很低，浪费大量能源。

senses.en: lacking the ability or skill to perform effectively

example.en: An inefficient manager can slow down the whole team.
example.zh: 能力不足的经理会拖慢整个团队的进度。

senses.en: a sharp pointed part on a plant stem

example.en: Be careful—the rose bush is covered in thorns.
example.zh: 小心——那丛玫瑰长满了刺。

senses.en: a source of persistent trouble or annoyance
senses.zh: 令人烦恼的根源；眼中钉

example.en: The border dispute has been a thorn in relations between the two countries.
example.zh: 边界争端一直是两国关系中的一根刺。

senses.en: the quality of not being proud or boastful about yourself

example.en: Her modesty made her popular with her colleagues.
example.zh: 她的谦逊使她深受同事欢迎。

senses.en: behavior or dress that is proper and not intended to attract sexual attention
senses.zh: 端庄；朴实（指衣着或行为）

example.en: She dressed with modesty for the formal ceremony.
example.zh: 她在正式典礼上穿着端庄。

senses.en: a small brownish-grey bird common in towns and fields

example.en: A sparrow hopped across the windowsill looking for crumbs.
example.zh: 一只麻雀在窗台上蹦跳着找面包屑。

senses.en: the country where you were born or that you belong to

example.en: After twenty years abroad, she finally returned to her homeland.
example.zh: 在国外生活二十年后，她终于回到了祖国。

senses.en: not connected with religion or spiritual matters

example.en: Many countries have a secular government that is separate from religious institutions.
example.zh: 许多国家的政府是世俗的，与宗教机构分离。

senses.en: lasting over a very long period of time (technical use)
senses.zh: 长期的；长时期延续的（术语用法）

example.en: The secular trend in the data shows steady population growth over centuries.
example.zh: 数据中的长期趋势显示人口经历了数百年的稳定增长。

senses.en: an abnormal growth of tissue in the body; may be benign or cancerous

example.en: The doctors found a small tumour in her lung.
example.zh: 医生在她的肺部发现了一个小肿瘤。

senses.en: a safe or peaceful place

example.en: The library was her haven from the noise of the city.
example.zh: 图书馆是她躲避城市喧嚣的避风港。

senses.en: a sheltered port for ships

example.en: The boats returned to the haven before the storm.
example.zh: 暴风雨来临前，船只返回了避风港。

senses.en: the process of appearing or becoming known

example.en: The emergence of new technology changed the industry.
example.zh: 新技术的出现改变了这个行业。

senses.en: a man whose job is to deliver mail

example.en: The postman delivers letters to our street every morning.
example.zh: 邮递员每天早上给我们这条街送信。

senses.en: a false spoken statement that damages someone's reputation

example.en: He sued his neighbor for slander.
example.zh: 他起诉邻居诽谤。

senses.en: to make false spoken statements that damage someone's reputation

example.en: He was accused of slandering his former business partner.
example.zh: 他被指控诽谤他以前的生意伙伴。

senses.en: the number 4; one more than three

example.en: There are four chairs in the room.
example.zh: 房间里有四把椅子。

senses.en: the digit or symbol 4

example.en: My seat number is four.
example.zh: 我的座位号是四。

senses.en: a playing card, die face, or team of four (especially in rowing)

example.en: She played the four of hearts.
example.zh: 她打出了红桃四。

senses.en: the grey or black gas produced when something burns

example.en: Smoke rose from the chimney.
example.zh: 烟从烟囱里升起。

senses.en: to breathe in and out the smoke of tobacco from a cigarette or pipe

example.en: He quit smoking last year.
example.zh: 他去年戒烟了。

senses.en: to give off smoke

example.en: The chimney was smoking heavily.
example.zh: 烟囱冒着浓烟。

senses.en: to preserve or flavour food by hanging it over burning wood

example.en: The factory smokes fish to give it flavor.
example.zh: 工厂通过熏制给鱼增添风味。

senses.en: the day on which a person was born; an annual celebration of that day

example.en: We are planning a surprise party for her birthday.
example.zh: 我们正在为她的生日策划一个惊喜派对。

senses.en: to stay alive with barely enough food or money

example.en: They subsisted on bread and water for weeks.
example.zh: 他们好几周只靠面包和水维持生活。

senses.en: a hard glossy coating applied to surfaces

example.en: The table has a beautiful red lacquer.
example.zh: 这张桌子有一层漂亮的红漆。

senses.en: to coat something with lacquer

example.en: They lacquered the wooden box to protect it.
example.zh: 他们给木盒上了漆以作保护。

senses.en: having lost a relative or close friend through death

example.en: The charity offers counseling for the bereaved.
example.zh: 该慈善机构为丧亲者提供心理疏导。

senses.en: people who have lost a relative or close friend

example.en: Condolences were sent to the bereaved.
example.zh: 慰问信被送到了遗属手中。

senses.en: red, hot and swollen because of injury or infection

example.en: The doctor examined the inflamed cut on his arm.
example.zh: 医生检查了他手臂上发炎的伤口。

senses.en: going against accepted beliefs or official teachings

example.en: He was punished for publishing a heretical book.
example.zh: 他因出版一本异端书籍而受到惩罚。

senses.en: a person who is very interested in and knowledgeable about a subject

example.en: He is a movie buff who watches films every weekend.
example.zh: 他是位影迷，每个周末都看电影。

senses.en: to polish something to make it shine

example.en: The mechanic buffed the car until it shone.
example.zh: 技工把汽车抛光得闪闪发亮。

senses.en: of a pale yellow-brown color

example.en: She wore a buff leather jacket.
example.zh: 她穿了一件米黄色皮夹克。

senses.en: the long hair growing on the neck of a horse, lion, or similar animal

example.en: The lion shook its thick mane.
example.zh: 狮子抖动了浓密的鬃毛。

senses.en: a large sum of money paid to someone, e.g. as insurance or compensation

example.en: She received a generous payout after leaving the company.
example.zh: 她离开公司时得到了一笔丰厚的补偿金。

senses.en: confident in a rude or aggressive way

example.en: The brash young salesman annoyed the customers.
example.zh: 那个傲慢的年轻推销员惹恼了顾客。

senses.en: to walk in a proud, confident way meant to impress others
senses.zh: 大摇大摆地走；昂首阔步

example.en: He swaggered into the room as if he owned the place.
example.zh: 他大摇大摆地走进房间，好像那里是他家似的。

senses.en: a proud, confident manner of walking or behaving
senses.zh: 趾高气扬；神气十足的步态

example.en: The champion walked off the court with plenty of swagger.
example.zh: 冠军神气十足地走下球场。

senses.en: to treat someone as if they are less intelligent or important
senses.zh: 摆出屈尊俯就的样子对待；以居高临下的态度对待

example.en: Stop patronising me and explain it properly.
example.zh: 别用那种居高临下的态度对我，好好解释一下。

senses.en: to be a regular customer of a shop or business

example.en: The café is patronised by locals and tourists alike.
example.zh: 这家咖啡馆受到当地人和游客的共同光顾。

senses.en: a set way of doing something, usually with clear steps

example.en: The school has a clear procedure for reporting accidents.
example.zh: 学校有明确的意外事故报告程序。

senses.en: a medical operation

example.en: The procedure took less than an hour.
example.zh: 这个手术用了不到一小时。

senses.en: a set of actions performed by a computer program

example.en: The program calls this procedure each time a user logs in.
example.zh: 用户每次登录时，程序都会调用这个过程。

senses.en: A large road vehicle that carries many passengers along a fixed route.
senses.zh: 沿固定路线运送许多乘客的大型道路车辆。

example.en: She takes the bus to school every morning.
example.zh: 她每天早晨坐公交车去上学。

senses.en: To travel by bus.

example.en: We bused into town after lunch.
example.zh: 午饭后我们坐公交车进城。

senses.en: To carry people by bus.

example.en: The company buses workers to the factory.
example.zh: 公司用公交车把工人送到工厂。

senses.en: A set of wires or channels that carries data or power between computer parts.
senses.zh: 总线；在计算机部件之间传输数据或电力的线路或通道。

example.en: The error came from a faulty data bus.
example.zh: 这个错误来自一条有故障的数据总线。

senses.en: a small round fruit with sweet flesh and a stone

example.en: She packed a ripe plum for lunch.
example.zh: 她带了一个熟李子当午餐。

senses.en: the tree that produces plums

example.en: A plum grows beside the garden wall.
example.zh: 花园墙边长着一棵李树。

senses.en: of a deep reddish-purple color

example.en: He wore a plum jacket to the party.
example.zh: 他穿了一件紫红色夹克去参加聚会。

senses.en: very desirable or profitable

example.en: She was offered a plum role in the new play.
example.zh: 她获邀在新剧中出演一个令人羡慕的角色。

senses.en: a chance to do something useful or desirable

example.en: She had the opportunity to study abroad for a year.
example.zh: 她有机会出国学习一年。

senses.en: a suitable time or situation for doing something

example.en: The meeting gave us an opportunity to discuss the plan.
example.zh: 这次会议给了我们讨论该计划的机会。

senses.en: a daughter or female member of a royal family

example.en: The princess waved to the crowd from the palace balcony.
example.zh: 公主在王宫阳台上向人群挥手。

senses.en: to sing with closed lips, or make a low steady sound

example.en: She was humming a tune while cooking dinner.
example.zh: 她做晚饭时哼着一支曲子。

senses.en: a low continuous sound, or the sound of busy activity

example.en: I could hear the hum of the machines in the factory.
example.zh: 我能听到工厂里机器的嗡嗡声。

senses.en: a sharp pain caused by a wound from an insect or plant

example.en: The sting of a bee can be very painful.
example.zh: 蜜蜂的蜇刺会非常疼。

senses.en: a sudden sharp mental pain or distress

example.en: He still felt the sting of her harsh words.
example.zh: 他仍感到她刻薄话带来的刺痛。

senses.en: to wound with a sting, or to cause a sharp burning pain

example.en: A wasp stung me on the arm.
example.zh: 一只黄蜂蜇了我的胳膊。

senses.en: one half of a sphere; one half of the Earth

example.en: Brazil lies in the southern hemisphere.
example.zh: 巴西位于南半球。

senses.en: one half of the brain

example.en: Each hemisphere of the brain controls the opposite side of the body.
example.zh: 大脑的每个半球控制身体的另一侧。

senses.en: poisonous; harmful to living things

example.en: Some mushrooms are highly toxic if eaten.
example.zh: 有些蘑菇食用后有剧毒。

senses.en: harmful or damaging in a relationship or environment

example.en: He finally left his toxic workplace.
example.zh: 他终于离开了那个风气恶劣的工作场所。

senses.en: a desire to hurt or annoy someone

example.en: He canceled the trip out of pure spite.
example.zh: 他纯粹出于怨恨取消了这次旅行。

senses.en: to deliberately annoy or hurt someone

example.en: She took the job just to spite her family.
example.zh: 她接受那份工作只是为了故意气她的家人。

senses.en: a small enclosed or partly enclosed space for a specific purpose, such as making a phone call or voting
senses.zh: 小隔间；亭子（如电话亭、投票亭）

example.en: There is a phone booth on the corner of the street.
example.zh: 街角有一个电话亭。

senses.en: a table in a restaurant or bar surrounded by two high-backed benches

example.en: We asked for a booth by the window.
example.zh: 我们要了一个靠窗的卡座。

senses.en: a temporary stand or stall used for selling goods or providing information

example.en: Our company set up a booth at the trade fair.
example.zh: 我们公司在交易会上设了一个展位。

senses.en: to use someone or something unfairly for one's own benefit

example.en: The company was accused of exploiting its workers.
example.zh: 这家公司被指控剥削工人。

senses.en: to make full use of something in order to gain an advantage

example.en: The country exploits its natural resources carefully.
example.zh: 这个国家谨慎地开发其自然资源。

senses.en: a bold or remarkable achievement

example.en: The book tells of his daring exploits during the war.
example.zh: 这本书讲述了他在战争期间的英勇事迹。

senses.en: to think about something carefully and for a long time

example.en: She sat by the window, contemplating her future.
example.zh: 她坐在窗边，思索着自己的未来。

senses.en: to consider as a possibility

example.en: They are contemplating moving to another city.
example.zh: 他们在考虑搬到另一个城市。

senses.en: to look at something thoughtfully

example.en: He stood contemplating the painting for several minutes.
example.zh: 他站着凝视那幅画了好几分钟。

senses.en: a person who works or swims underwater using special equipment

example.en: The diver explored the sunken ship.
example.zh: 潜水员探索了沉船。

senses.en: a person who dives headfirst into water, such as a competitor in diving

example.en: The diver scored high on her final dive.
example.zh: 这位跳水运动员最后一跳得了高分。

senses.en: to stop a feeling, sound, or laugh from showing

example.en: She stifled a laugh during the meeting.
example.zh: 开会时她忍住了笑。

senses.en: to prevent growth, freedom, or development

example.en: Too many rules can stifle creativity.
example.zh: 过多的规则会扼杀创造力。

senses.en: to make it difficult to breathe

example.en: The smoke from the fire stifled the firefighters.
example.zh: 大火产生的浓烟使消防员呼吸困难。

senses.en: a person who works for an expert to learn a trade

example.en: She worked as an apprentice to a carpenter for two years.
example.zh: 她给一位木匠当了两年学徒。

senses.en: to make someone an apprentice, or to work as one

example.en: His father apprenticed him to a local printer.
example.zh: 他父亲让他到当地一家印刷所学徒。

senses.en: a dangerous or unusual act performed for entertainment or attention

example.en: The actor performed his own stunts in the film.
example.zh: 这位演员在电影中亲自表演特技。

senses.en: to prevent something or someone from growing or developing fully

example.en: Poor nutrition can stunt a child's growth.
example.zh: 营养不良会阻碍儿童的生长发育。

senses.en: something done to attract public attention

example.en: Critics called the announcement a publicity stunt.
example.zh: 批评者称这一宣布只是宣传噱头。

senses.en: to ask someone a series of questions, often formally or forcefully

example.en: The police interrogated the suspect for several hours.
example.zh: 警方审问了嫌疑人几个小时。

senses.en: to send a signal to a device to trigger a response, as in telecommunications

example.en: The system interrogates each sensor every few seconds.
example.zh: 系统每隔几秒查询一次每个传感器。

senses.en: the leader or chief of a village, tribe or clan

example.en: The villagers brought their dispute to the headman.
example.zh: 村民们把争端提交给村长。

senses.en: a horse of a breed developed for racing

example.en: The thoroughbred won the race by two lengths.
example.zh: 这匹纯种赛马以两个马身的优势赢得比赛。

senses.en: (of an animal) of pure breed, with a recorded pedigree

example.en: She owns a stable of thoroughbred horses.
example.zh: 她拥有一批纯种马。

senses.en: physical weakness, especially from old age
senses.zh: 体弱；虚弱（尤指年老所致）

example.en: Despite his infirmity, he still walked every morning.
example.zh: 尽管身体虚弱，他仍然每天早晨散步。

senses.en: wicked or sinful

example.en: The novel describes an ungodly tyrant who rules without mercy.
example.zh: 小说描写了一个毫无怜悯的邪恶暴君。

senses.en: unreasonably early or extreme (informal)

example.en: We had to get up at an ungodly hour to catch the flight.
example.zh: 为了赶飞机，我们不得不在离谱的时间起床。

senses.en: a hood, especially one attached to a robe, such as that worn by a monk

example.en: The monk pulled his cowl over his head.
example.zh: 修士把兜帽拉到头上。

senses.en: a metal cover over an engine or vent

example.en: The mechanic opened the cowl to inspect the engine.
example.zh: 机械师打开引擎罩检查发动机。

senses.en: a thin stick used by a magician, especially for performing magic tricks

example.en: The magician waved his wand and the rabbit disappeared.
example.zh: 魔术师一挥魔杖，兔子就消失了。

senses.en: the process of developing industries in a country or region on a large scale

example.en: Industrialization transformed the country's economy.
example.zh: 工业化改变了该国的经济。

senses.en: to show something off proudly in order to impress people

example.en: He flaunted his new sports car in front of his neighbors.
example.zh: 他在邻居面前炫耀他的新跑车。

senses.en: to openly disregard a rule or law

example.en: The company flaunted safety regulations.
example.zh: 该公司公然无视安全规定。

senses.en: charmingly simple, peaceful, and beautiful

example.en: They spent a week in an idyllic village by the lake.
example.zh: 他们在湖边一个田园般的村庄度过了一周。

senses.en: illnesses that affect the body or a part of it

example.en: Doctors are working to prevent the spread of diseases.
example.zh: 医生们正努力防止疾病传播。

senses.en: plural of emergency; sudden dangerous situations needing immediate action
senses.zh: 紧急情况；突发事件（emergency的复数）

example.en: Nurses are trained to handle emergencies calmly.
example.zh: 护士接受过冷静处理紧急情况的训练。

senses.en: a verb form ending in -ing that functions as a noun

example.en: In the sentence "Swimming is fun," "swimming" is a gerund.
example.zh: 在句子 "Swimming is fun" 中，"swimming" 是动名词。

senses.en: causing great sadness or sorrow

example.en: The heartrending story of the lost child moved everyone to tears.
example.zh: 那个走失孩子的心碎故事让所有人都流下了眼泪。
